{{Quote|There are no nearby planets capable of supporting life and no trade routes exist in this sector.|A [[Unidentified captain (Endor)|captain]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Navy]] describes the area around RZ7-6113-23|<ref name="Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 1">[[Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost 1|''Crimson Empire III: Empire Lost'' 1]]</ref>}}
The '''Chopani sector''' was a [[Sector/Legends|sector]] located within the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. It bordered the [[Veragi sector/Legends|Veragi]], [[Raioballo sector/Legends|Raioballo]], [[Relgim sector/Legends|Relgim]], [[Kanz sector/Legends|Kanz]] and [[Dalonbian sector/Legends|Dalonbian sectors]], and contained the [[Void of Chopani/Legends|Void of Chopani]] and the planets [[Antmuel VI]] and [[RZ7-6113-23]].
